verses.en: Woe to those who give short measure,
who demand of other people full measure for themselves,
verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ

verses.en: but give less than they should when it is they who weigh or measure for others!
Do these people not realize that they will be raised up
on a mighty Day,
a Day when everyone will stand before the Lord of the Worlds?
No indeed! The list of the wicked is in Sijjin––
verses.ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍ

verses.en: what will explain to you what Sijjin is?––
a clearly numbered list.
Woe on that day to the deniers,
those who deny the Day of Judgement!
Only the evil aggressor denies it:
verses.ar: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ

verses.en: when Our revelations are recited to him, he says, ‘Ancient fables!’
verses.ar: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

verses.en: No indeed! Their hearts are encrusted with what they have done.
verses.ar: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ

verses.en: No indeed! On that Day they will be screened off from their Lord,
verses.ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ

verses.en: they will burn in Hell,
and they will be told, ‘This is what you called a lie.’
verses.ar: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ

verses.en: No indeed! The list of the truly good is in 'Illiyyin––
verses.ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ

verses.en: what will explain to you what 'Illiyyin is?––
a clearly written list,
witnessed by those brought near.
The truly good will live in bliss,
seated on couches, gazing around.
You will recognize on their faces the radiance of bliss.
They will be served a sealed nectar,
its seal [perfumed with] a fragrant herb––let those who strive, strive for this––
verses.ar: خِتَـٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَـٰفِسُونَ

verses.en: mixed with the water of Tasnim,
a spring from which those brought near will drink.
The wicked used to laugh at the believers––
verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ

verses.en: they would wink at one another when the believers passed by them,
joke about them when they got back to their own people,
verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ

verses.en: and say, when they saw them, ‘These people are misguided,’
verses.ar: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ

verses.en: though they were not sent to be their keepers-
so today the believers are laughing at the disbelievers
verses.ar: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ

verses.en: as they sit on couches, gazing around.
Have the disbelievers [not] been repaid for their deeds?
verses.ar: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
